words.sense: provoke someone into action through criticism, challenges or irritation
misconceptions: Thinking any persistent persuasion is harsh.
Treating supportive patience as emotional provocation.

words.sense: persuade gently and patiently through reassuring encouragement
misconceptions: Confusing a resulting action with the method used.

semantic_axes.description: Goading drives action through provocation or emotional pressure, whereas coaxing invites it through gentle, patient encouragement.

edges.boundary_rule: Goading drives action through provocation or emotional pressure, whereas coaxing invites it through gentle, patient encouragement.

misconceptions.M1: Thinking any persistent persuasion is harsh.
misconceptions.M2: Confusing a resulting action with the method used.
misconceptions.M3: Treating supportive patience as emotional provocation.

chains.frame: Which word best describes how Amina pushed Sef to finish his slide?

beats.text: Amina keeps saying, “Everyone else managed theirs,” whenever Sef pauses over the slide.
beats.decisive_clue: she uses comparison to sting him into working
beats.reason: She uses comparison to sting him into working is the evidence for goad.

beats.text: She repeats the comparison in front of the whole group when the deadline gets close.
beats.decisive_clue: the repeated public comparison still pressures him
beats.reason: Public repetition intensifies the existing challenge; it does not become gentle encouragement.

chains.feedback_short: The deciding clue: she uses comparison to sting him into working.
chains.feedback_deep: Goading uses pointed pressure or irritation to trigger action. Amina relies on comparison and embarrassment; coaxing would be patient reassurance.
chains.contrast_rule: Goad with a jab; coax with patience.

chains.frame: Which word best describes how Kenji encouraged his niece to enter the pool?

beats.text: Kenji sits beside her, offers his hand and says she can try just one step whenever she feels ready.
beats.decisive_clue: he offers a patient invitation with control left to her
beats.reason: He offers a patient invitation with control left to her is the evidence for coax.

beats.text: When she hesitates, he waits without pulling her closer.
beats.decisive_clue: he waits without forcing a response
beats.reason: His willingness to wait confirms gentle persuasion rather than provocation.

chains.feedback_short: The deciding clue: he waits without forcing a response.
chains.feedback_deep: Coaxing relies on patience and reassurance while the other person chooses. Kenji avoids irritation or dares.
chains.contrast_rule: Goad with a jab; coax with patience.

chains.frame: Which word best describes how Idris got Leo to attempt the difficult jump?

beats.text: Idris smiles and says, “Try the smaller version first; I’ll show you how,” until Leo nods.
beats.decisive_clue: he initially reassures Leo with an easier step
beats.reason: He initially reassures Leo with an easier step is the evidence for coax.

beats.text: Then Idris adds, “Unless you’re scared to let the team see you fail.”
beats.decisive_clue: he adds a challenge meant to sting Leo into acting
beats.reason: The challenge changes the pressure tactic from supportive invitation to provocation.

chains.feedback_short: The deciding clue: he adds a challenge meant to sting Leo into acting.
chains.feedback_deep: The initial method is coaxing because it offers an easier step. The added taunt pressures Leo through fear of looking cowardly, which better fits goading.
chains.contrast_rule: Goad with a jab; coax with patience.

chains.frame: Which word best describes how Sofia tried to get Noura onto the ferry?

beats.text: Sofia sends Noura a calm message offering to stand with her the entire short ride.
beats.decisive_clue: she reassures Noura without taking away her choice
beats.reason: She reassures Noura without taking away her choice is the evidence for coax.

beats.text: She adds that they can leave the queue if Noura changes her mind.
beats.decisive_clue: the option to leave keeps the invitation voluntary
beats.reason: Giving an exit option supports the patient invitation rather than increasing emotional pressure.

chains.feedback_short: The deciding clue: she reassures Noura without taking away her choice.
chains.feedback_deep: Coaxing can involve repeated encouragement, but its method remains gentle. Sofia leaves the choice with Noura.
chains.contrast_rule: Goad with a jab; coax with patience.

chains.frame: Which word best describes how Malik pressed his teammate to join one more match?

beats.text: Malik keeps typing, “So you quit whenever the score gets tough?” until his teammate rejoins.
beats.decisive_clue: he uses repeated accusations to provoke a response
beats.reason: He uses repeated accusations to provoke a response is the evidence for goad.

beats.text: He points out every time the teammate has backed out this week.
beats.decisive_clue: the original accusatory taunt is still the decisive method
beats.reason: The history of past matches adds context but does not change how Malik provokes his teammate.

chains.feedback_short: The deciding clue: he uses repeated accusations to provoke a response.
chains.feedback_deep: Goading works through irritating challenges or criticism. Malik’s accusations are decisive; counting previous games is incidental to that method.
chains.contrast_rule: Goad with a jab; coax with patience.

chains.frame: Which word best describes how Priya got her brother to try the coat?

beats.text: Priya tells her brother the colour suits him and offers to fetch another size if the first one feels awkward.
beats.decisive_clue: she encourages him with kind words and a helpful offer
beats.reason: She encourages him with kind words and a helpful offer is the evidence for coax.

beats.text: She lets him study himself in the mirror and waits until he asks to try it.
beats.decisive_clue: she patiently gives him control over the choice
beats.reason: Giving him time and a choice confirms reassurance instead of provoking him through embarrassment.

chains.feedback_short: The deciding clue: she patiently gives him control over the choice.
chains.feedback_deep: Coaxing means persuading through warmth and gentle persistence. Priya’s compliments and helpful offer invite a choice, unlike goading through challenges.
chains.contrast_rule: Goad with a jab; coax with patience.
